builds.goal: Reference for Rek'Sai: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A tunnel-based melee ambusher who uses burrowed tracking to choose an entry, then spends Fury on a bite or recovery. Fix burrow state, Fury spent on bite versus healing and tunnel access. True-damage components and R target access must not be awarded to every physical hit. Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.

testPlan: Kit question for Rek'Sai: Fix burrow state, Fury spent on bite versus healing and tunnel access. True-damage components and R target access must not be awarded to every physical hit.

Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength.
